channel.title: The Crucible on r1skers' Blog
channel.description: Recent content in The Crucible on r1skers' Blog

item.title: [The Crucible] Embedded C Chronicles: Traps, Idioms, and Best Practices
item.description: A living collection of engineering wisdom and lessons learned from STM32 development. Covering topics from timer overflows to memory management.

item.title: [The Crucible] Is Probability Just Normalized Energy? The Hidden Link between Born's Rule and Auto-correlation
item.description: Bridging the gap between Signal Processing and Quantum Mechanics. A mathematical exploration of how Hilbert Space inner products unify the concepts of Energy and Existence.

item.title: [The Crucible] Quantum Mechanics Part 1: From Schrödinger to Wave Functions
item.description: Exploring the probabilistic nature of the quantum world. A derivation of the Schrödinger equation and visualization of wave functions using Python (Matplotlib).

item.title: [The Crucible] Convolution and Sampling in Fourier and Laplace
item.description: Unveiling the mathematical symmetry between Time and Frequency domains. A deep dive into why multiplication in one domain equals convolution in the other, and the mystery of spectrum replication.

item.title: [The Crucible] RLC Circuit Analysis: Differential Equations vs. Laplace Transform
item.description: Reflecting on the two distinct mathematical approaches to circuit analysis. Why do we shift from the tangible time domain to the abstract s-domain? A journey through the mathematical machinery of RLC circuits.

item.title: [The Crucible] Markdown Functionality Test (LaTeX and Mermaid)
item.description: A meta-post testing the rendering capabilities of this blog. Including mathematical formulas (KaTeX) and diagrams (Mermaid).
